thesis: The page is a house almanac: each season opens as an editorial spread datelined to a Chattanooga neighborhood, and the signature is a brass season dial that turns as you scroll through the year's care.

signature.name: Season Dial
signature.summary: Circular four-segment brass dial (Spring·Summer·Fall·Winter) pinned top-right desktop / sticky pill mobile; active quarter fills via --sw-p at each almanac spread. Reused in hero masthead, four season spreads, proof review tags, and footer reset.
